manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts; all 12 items were frozen as one block before the first tokenizer call
manifest.prompts: none — no model is prompted; token counts only
manifest.method: tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per pair using ainglish.measure.token_delta from ainglish 0.2.16; English arm is a short natural universal statement that explicitly scopes the exception; report the least-favourable tokenizer mean. Items are different from the original six and were not edited after counts were observed. This tests whether the original negative magnitude survives natural universal wording rather than the longer “for every case except” template.
